title: 八归·湘中送胡德华
title_en: Ba Gui: Seeing Off Hu Dehua in Hunan
author: 姜夔

form.en: ci, a long lyric in two stanzas

text_note.zh: 语料库第二句作“蔬桐吹绿”，“蔬”是繁体转简体时的错字，通行本作“疏桐”（枝叶稀疏的梧桐），这里用通行本。语料库只有词牌名，通行本有题目“湘中送胡德华”。
text_note.en: In line two the corpus has shū (vegetable), a slip from converting the text to simplified characters. The usual text has shū meaning sparse, for a thinly leaved parasol tree; this page follows it. The corpus gives only the tune name; the usual text has the title "Seeing Off Hu Dehua in Hunan".

glosses.zh: 芳莲坠粉：荷花凋谢，粉红的花瓣掉落下来。
glosses.en: fāng lián zhuì fěn: the lotus fades, and its pink petals drop.

glosses.zh: 疏桐吹绿：风吹着枝叶稀疏的梧桐，绿叶飘落。
glosses.en: shū tóng chuī lǜ: the wind blows the thin parasol tree, and green leaves fall.

glosses.zh: 暗雨：夜里下的雨，看不见，只听得到。
glosses.en: àn yǔ: rain at night, heard but not seen.

glosses.zh: 乍歇：刚刚停下。
glosses.en: zhà xiē: has just stopped.

glosses.zh: 无端：没来由地，不知怎么地。
glosses.en: wú duān: for no clear reason.

glosses.zh: 抱影：守着自己的影子，形容孤单一人。
glosses.en: bào yǐng: keeping company with one's own shadow, that is, being all alone.

glosses.zh: 销魂：伤心得好像魂都没了。
glosses.en: xiāo hún: so sad it feels as if your soul is melting away.

glosses.zh: 筱墙：长着小竹子的墙边。筱，细小的竹子。
glosses.en: xiǎo qiáng: a wall lined with thin bamboo. Xiǎo is slender bamboo.

glosses.zh: 萤暗：萤火虫的光暗暗的。
glosses.en: yíng àn: the glow of fireflies is dim.

glosses.zh: 藓阶：长了青苔的台阶。
glosses.en: xiǎn jiē: steps covered with moss.

glosses.zh: 蛩切：蟋蟀叫得很急、很凄凉。蛩，蟋蟀。
glosses.en: qióng qiè: crickets chirp fast and sadly. Qióng is a cricket.

glosses.zh: 重寻：又一次走上。
glosses.en: chóng xún: to walk again.

glosses.zh: 琵琶谁拨：是谁在弹琵琶？这里用了白居易《琵琶行》的意思，那首诗写的也是江边送客时听到琵琶。
glosses.en: pí pá shuí bō: who is playing the pipa? This echoes Bai Juyi's "Song of the Pipa", which is also about hearing a pipa while seeing off a guest by the river.

glosses.zh: 付与：交给。
glosses.en: fù yǔ: to hand over to.

glosses.zh: 啼鴂：啼叫的鹈鴂鸟，一种像杜鹃的鸟。古人说它一叫，花草就要凋零了。
glosses.en: tí jué: the crying tí jué bird, a bird like the cuckoo. People of old said that when it cried, flowers and grass would wither.

glosses.zh: 相从未款：在一起的时间太短，还没有好好地相聚。款，尽情、畅快。
glosses.en: xiāng cóng wèi kuǎn: our time together was too short, and we never had our fill of it. Kuǎn means to one's heart's content.

glosses.zh: 西风：秋风。
glosses.en: xī fēng: the west wind, that is, the autumn wind.

glosses.zh: 渚：水中的小块陆地。
glosses.en: zhǔ: a small islet in the water.

glosses.zh: 棹：船桨，这里指船。
glosses.en: zhào: an oar, here meaning the boat.

glosses.zh: 缥缈：隐隐约约，看不太清楚。
glosses.en: piāo miǎo: faint and dim, hard to see clearly.

glosses.zh: 文君：卓文君，汉代司马相如的妻子。这里借指胡德华的妻子。
glosses.en: wén jūn: Zhuo Wenjun, wife of Sima Xiangru in the Han dynasty. Here it means Hu Dehua's wife.

glosses.zh: 倚竹：靠着竹子。出自杜甫《佳人》“天寒翠袖薄，日暮倚修竹”，写女子孤单等待。
glosses.en: yǐ zhú: leaning on bamboo. It comes from Du Fu's poem "The Beauty", about a woman waiting alone at dusk.

glosses.zh: 步罗袜：穿着丝袜轻轻走动。罗袜，丝织的袜子。
glosses.en: bù luó wà: walking softly in silk stockings.

glosses.zh: 翠尊：翠绿色的酒杯。
glosses.en: cuì zūn: a jade-green wine cup.

glosses.zh: 玲珑：精巧明亮，这里形容珠帘透进月光的样子。
glosses.en: líng lóng: fine and bright, here describing moonlight shining through the bead curtain.

translation.zh: 荷花凋谢，粉色的花瓣纷纷落下，
translation.en: The lotus fades and its pink petals fall;

translation.zh: 风吹着稀疏的梧桐，绿叶飘零，
translation.en: wind blows the thin parasol tree, and green leaves drift down;

translation.zh: 院子里夜雨刚刚停。
translation.en: in the courtyard the night rain has just stopped.

translation.zh: 不知怎么，我独自对着影子，伤心极了，
translation.en: For no clear reason I sit alone with my shadow, heartbroken,

translation.zh: 又看见竹墙边萤火虫光暗暗的，
translation.en: and see fireflies glowing faintly by the bamboo wall,

translation.zh: 长满青苔的台阶下蟋蟀叫得凄切。
translation.en: and hear crickets crying sadly by the mossy steps.

translation.zh: 为了送你，我又一次走上向西的路。
translation.en: To see you off, I walk again the road going west.

translation.zh: 问一问水面上，
translation.en: I ask the water:

translation.zh: 是谁在弹琵琶？
translation.en: who is playing the pipa?

translation.zh: 最可惜的是，
translation.en: Most pitiful of all,

translation.zh: 这一片大好江山，
translation.en: this whole fine land of rivers and hills

translation.zh: 都交给了啼叫的鹈鴂鸟。
translation.en: is handed over to the crying tí jué birds.

translation.zh: 我一直遗憾我们相聚太短，
translation.en: I have always regretted that our time together was too short.

translation.zh: 如今为什么，
translation.en: Why now

translation.zh: 又要在秋风里分别？
translation.en: must we part again in the autumn wind?

translation.zh: 小洲寒冷，烟雾淡淡，
translation.en: The islet is cold and the mist is thin;

translation.zh: 船桨划动，人越走越远，
translation.en: the oars move and you go farther and farther,

translation.zh: 远去的船隐隐约约，像一片小树叶。
translation.en: your boat fading in the distance like a tiny leaf.

translation.zh: 我想你的妻子已经盼了你很久，
translation.en: I think of your wife, who has waited for you so long,

translation.zh: 靠着竹子，满怀愁绪，穿着丝袜轻轻走来走去。
translation.en: leaning on the bamboo, full of worry, pacing softly in silk stockings.

translation.zh: 你回家以后，
translation.en: When you get home,

translation.zh: 两人一起举起翠绿的酒杯，
translation.en: you two will raise green cups and drink together,

translation.zh: 放下珠帘，
translation.en: let down the bead curtain,

translation.zh: 悠闲地看着透过珠帘的明亮月光。
translation.en: and gaze at ease at the bright moon through it.

background.zh: 题目里的“湘中”指今天的湖南一带。姜夔年轻时在湖南住过一段时间，一说这首词写于他在长沙的时候。胡德华是他的朋友，生平已经不太清楚。秋天，朋友要坐船离开，回家与妻子团聚，姜夔在江边送他，写下了这首词。
background.en: Xiangzhong in the title means the Hunan region of today. Jiang Kui lived in Hunan for a time when he was young, and one view is that this lyric was written while he was in Changsha. Hu Dehua was his friend; little is known about his life now. One autumn, the friend was leaving by boat to go home to his wife. Jiang Kui saw him off by the river and wrote this lyric.

author_note.zh: 姜夔（约1155—约1221），号白石道人，南宋词人，也是音乐家。他一生没有做官，靠朋友接济，到处漂泊。他懂音乐，能自己作曲。他的词清冷、雅致，常写离别和孤独，这首词也是这样。
author_note.en: Jiang Kui (about 1155 to about 1221), also called the Taoist of White Stone, was a Southern Song lyric writer and also a musician. He never held office, lived on the help of friends and moved from place to place. He knew music well and could write his own tunes. His lyrics are cool and refined, often about parting and loneliness, as this one is.

appreciation.zh: 上半首先写秋夜：荷花落了，梧桐叶飘了，雨刚停，萤火虫暗暗的，蟋蟀叫得人心慌。还没写送别，景色已经满是愁。接着写送朋友上路，水面传来琵琶声，好像《琵琶行》里的江边送客。下半首写分别：两人刚见面不久又要分开，船越走越远，最后像一片树叶。到这里本该很伤心，可作者笔锋一转，去想朋友回家后的样子：妻子在家盼着他，两人一起喝酒、看月亮。用别人的团圆来送别，既是真心的祝福，也更衬出作者自己的孤单。
appreciation.en: The first half paints an autumn night: lotus petals have fallen, parasol leaves drift down, the rain has just stopped, fireflies glow faintly, and crickets chirp until your heart aches. Before the parting is even mentioned, the scene is full of sorrow. Then he sees his friend off. The sound of a pipa comes over the water, just like the river farewell in "Song of the Pipa". The second half is about the parting. They met so recently and must part again. The boat goes farther and farther until it is like a leaf. Here we expect deep grief, but the poet turns and imagines his friend at home. His wife has waited for him, and they drink together and look at the moon. Using someone else's reunion to say goodbye is a true blessing, and it also makes the poet's own loneliness stand out.
